jest/no-restricted-matchers.toBeDefined: Assert the exact value (toBe, toEqual, toMatchObject with a literal); a loose matcher passes when the code returns the wrong thing.

jest/no-restricted-matchers.not.toThrow: Assert what the call returns or changes; not throwing passes when it does nothing.
